format: CSV, one file per local month and agency (avl_YYYY-MM_<AGENCY>.csv), sorted by time

fields.name: latitude
fields.notes: WGS84, on a road centreline of the reference network

fields.name: status
fields.notes: ENR en route, ONS on scene, TRN transporting, HSP at hospital, RTQ returning to quarters, AIQ available in quarters, LOAD/UNLD bus loading and unloading, STG staged

fields.name: incident_number
fields.notes: 911 incident, evacuation route id (EVAC-*) or convoy id; empty when returning or in quarters

cadence: fire and EMS units every 15 s responding to a priority 1 call and 30 s otherwise; patrol units every 30 or 60 s; 60 s transporting; 180 s returning; two fixes while parked; a heartbeat every 6 h in quarters. Long, slow legs report by distance (at most 22 fixes per leg).
